subject: R2 75cc still HOLD: launch metadata values remain unbound
body: Reviewed current head 75cc29e75f9bc22d9ebf29bfe464158fa737261e. Host-resource guard and its bindings/tests are useful and PASS in principle, but run_durable_process.py still validates only that repo_head/spec_path/spec_sha256/runtime_binding_sha256 are nonempty strings. It does not prove those values match the checked-out HEAD, frozen R2 spec path, recomputed spec SHA, or spec runtime binding. Search found no separate R2 launch validator. Therefore the prior metadata-value HOLD remains. Repair must fail closed before Popen on well-formed-but-wrong values. Training recipe remains accepted; GPU launch remains HOLD.
